date_scope_check.qualification: EA011-D1: Crossing-specific reporting dates Laiza closure October 18, 2024; RFA broadly says October 19. Reopening reports disagree: KIO spokesperson quoted by Myitkyina Journal gives October 24 at 23:59, Irrawaddy reports Saturday October 25, and Mizzima gives October 26. Preserve October 24–26 as a reported endpoint range rather than choosing one exact day. December 13, 2024 removal of Laiza barriers did not establish passage: contemporary KNG reporting explicitly says people, vehicles and goods were still not allowed. Kan Paik Ti had separate earlier partial reopening. These reports do not independently establish uninterrupted closure for all categories or every Kachin crossing. The October fuel restriction is not a current-status assertion: Network Media Group reported limited fuel tankers entering Laiza–Nabang by November 26, 2025, but first passage, retail availability and full policy repeal remain unknown.
